title: [PowerAccent] Hide stuck accent toolbar when focus leaves the window
author: amail80
summary: The author applied the prior foreground-event ordering review on the current upstream head. The final Copilot pass produced zero new comments, all fork threads are resolved, the full Power Accent Debug chain builds, and 55 targeted tests pass. proposed_comments.title: Keep the cancelled owner key suppressed until release

confidence.rationale: ForceReset deterministically clears letterPressed while the physical key may remain held, so the next repeat enters the new-gesture path. The inverse missed-key-up case can also make naive suppression permanent; both paths follow directly from the changed callback and existing key handlers.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the cancelled owner key suppressed until release

**Severity:** `medium`

`ForegroundEventProc` calls `ForceReset()`, which clears the owner letter. If that physical key is still held after focus moves, its next auto-repeat is treated as a new gesture and can reopen the toolbar in the destination window, undoing the cancellation. Track the foreground-cancelled owner separately, swallow its repeat key-downs until release, and clear stale suppression when `GetAsyncKeyState` shows the key is already up (including on a later foreground notification), so a key-up missed while crossing an elevated process cannot permanently disable that letter.

proposed_comments.title: Add the comma required by the spelling rule

confidence.rationale: The fork check-spelling workflow reported this exact current-diff line as a forbidden pattern and passed after the comma was added.

proposed_comments.body:
### Add the comma required by the spelling rule

**Severity:** `low`

The repository spelling rule flags `Otherwise cancel` and requires a comma after the introductory adverb. Adding it keeps the current diff clear of that check-spelling failure.
